title: Khat Sughra ka Aaya Hai
body:
Khat sughra ka aaya hai.  (4)
Roke ye sarwar ne kaha .... Khat sughra ka aaya hai
Utho jara utho bete ....khat sughra ka aaya hai...
Khat sughra ka aaya hai...(2)
(1) Aankh me aansu bahete the roke sarvar kahetethe
Dekh to lo uth kar lillah...
Khat sughra ka aaya hai...(2)
(2) Aye Akabar aye Jane watan rasta takti Teri bahan
Kab tak royengi sughra......
Khat sughra ka aaya hai...(2)
(3) Khat ko sunate jate hai sarvar rote jate hai..(2)
Aur ye karte hai nouha....
Khat sughra ka aaya hai...(2)
(4) Kaheti hai bimar hu mai Bhai mere lachar hu mai
Lene mujhe jaldi aajaa....
Khat sughra ka aaya hai...(2)
(5) Sahera tera sajvaungi mahedi tujhe lagvaungi(2)
Tujhko banaungi dulha...
Khat sughra ka aaya hai...(2)
(6) Aur na ab ji paungi baba mai marjaungi (2)
Hal hai ab marjane ka ......
Khat sughra ka aaya hai...(2)
(7) Lashe pe khat ko rakh k sarvar rokar kahene large
Likho javab e khat to Zara...
Khat sughra ka aaya hai...(2)
(8)Nouha tum''Rehan''pado sath "suhail" k jiqr karo...(2)
Haider ki hai dilse dua....
Khat sughra ka aaya hai...(2)
